nodes.title: Weigh brass
nodes.description: Weigh the brass sample on the analytical balance.

feedback.retry: Review Weigh brass and try again.

nodes.title: Observe dissolution
nodes.description: Record that nitric acid dissolution is complete before dilution.

feedback.retry: Review Observe dissolution and try again.

nodes.title: Transfer brass solution
nodes.description: Pour the dissolved brass solution into the volumetric flask.

feedback.retry: Review Transfer brass solution and try again.

nodes.title: Dilute brass solution
nodes.description: Pour deionized water into the brass solution to the calibration mark.

feedback.retry: Review Dilute brass solution and try again.

nodes.title: Fill cuvette
nodes.description: Pour the diluted brass sample into the cuvette.

feedback.retry: Review Fill cuvette and try again.

nodes.title: Record absorbance
nodes.description: Record absorbance for the diluted brass solution.

feedback.retry: Review Record absorbance and try again.

nodes.title: Calculate copper percent
nodes.description: Calculate copper percent from the calibration curve and brass mass.

feedback.retry: Review Calculate copper percent and try again.
